title: iARCS: Iterative Agentic RL for Controllable 3D Scene Generation
abstract: Synthetic 3D scene generation is increasingly used as a data source for computer vision and embodied AI, but existing generators often optimize perceptual realism without reliably satisfying task-critical functional constraints. This mismatch limits the usefulness of synthetic data for downstream training, where accessibility, traversability, and spatial rule compliance are often essential. We present iARCS, an iterative agentic reinforcement learning framework that adapts a pretrained scene generator to natural-language task requirements. iARCS uses a two-stage strategy: universal-reward pretraining to improve physical plausibility and layout quality, followed by task-specific fine-tuning with LLM-generated reward programs that are iteratively refined from training feedback. Experiments show improved constraint fidelity on walkability, reachability, and clearance-focused tasks, effective task-specific constraint optimization, and competitive scene diversity. We further show that data generated by iARCS improves a base generator, supporting its value as a practical synthetic data generation tool rather than only a controllable scene editing method.

analysis.sourceNote: 依据 arXiv 2608.06161v1 全文整理；PDF 未提供 project page 或 code repository URL。
analysis.ideaZh: 用两阶段 RL 把 pretrained 3D room prior 变成满足功能约束的 task-specific generator：先学习 universal physical rewards，再由 LLM 生成并反思 executable task rewards。
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 它把自然语言需求、executable geometric constraints 与 rendered feedback 连成 agentic 3D generation loop，直接关联 controllable 3D scenes 和 Visual Design Agents。
analysis.evidenceZh: 作者报告相对 MiDiffusion，iARCS 的 object/scene collision 从 52.67%/81.67% 降到 40.45%/64.63%，walkability 从 0.806 升到 0.861，但 FID 从 1.34 变为 1.60；用 4,000 个生成 scenes 扩充训练后，scene collision 降到 63.61%、reachability 升至 92.52%，FID 保持 1.34（Tables 1–2, p. 7）。
analysis.caveatZh: 每种自然语言任务最终训练一个独立 LoRA/RL policy，并不是 prompt-time zero-shot controllable generator；实验只覆盖 3D-FRONT bedrooms，reward reflection、LLM reward 与人写 reward 的独立贡献也未完整消融。
analysis.motivationZh: 现有 3D scene generators 往往优化视觉分布，却不稳定满足 collision、boundary、walkability、reachability 等功能约束，因而生成数据难以直接用于 embodied tasks。
analysis.methodZh: Stage 1 用手写 universal rewards 通过 DDPO 修正 physical plausibility 与 functional utility；Stage 2 由 LLM 把 prompt 分解为可测几何条件并写成 reward program，再每 10 epochs 读取 rollout statistics 与 top-down renders，调整 reward 和 curriculum。
analysis.experimentsZh: 作者以 MiDiffusion/3D-FRONT bedroom 为 base，评测 1,080 samples 的 FID/SCA、3D collision、out-of-bound、reachability 与 walkability，并生成 4,000 scenes 做 self-augmentation。two-stage 优于同 reward level 的 single-stage，但强 constraint-aware baselines 与 agentic-loop 组件消融仍不足。
analysis.insightZh: agent 在这里不是替模型直接摆放每个 object，而是把模糊需求编译成可执行 optimization objective，并用生成统计反过来调试 reward；这是可迁移的 design-loop 形式，但代价是 per-task training。
